sources.snippet: The SEA-LION-Embedding-E5-600M model is a Sentence Transformer optimised for 11 Southeast Asian languages. It has been fine-tuned from the multilingual-e5-large base, mapping sentences and paragraphs to a 1024-dimensional dense vector space.

sources.snippet: SEA-LION-Embedding-E5 (Semantic Precision)): Fine-tuned from the E5-large foundation, these models are designed for maximum semantic accuracy in retrieval and similarity tasks across the region's diverse linguistic landscape.
